parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The random variable $Y$ has the distribution $\text{Po}(\mu)$ where $\mu$ is large. Using a suitable approximating distribution, it is found that $\text{P}(Y < 46) = 0.0668$, correct to 4 decimal places.

Find $\mu$.
